title: Runtime Monitoring and Enforcement of Conditional Fairness in Generative AIs

bias_targets.methodology: Generating image sequences from neutral prompts and using a vision-attribute identification model to classify the gender of the generated characters, then measuring the mathematical distance (bounded repeated appearance) between appearances of each gender.

Tracking the race or ethnicity (e.g., Asian, Caucasian, African American, Latino, Native American) of characters in generated image sequences to evaluate if all groups appear within a specified bounded sequence length.
Using concept grouping functions to categorize the perceived age (child, adult, elderly) of generated image characters and monitoring their eventual or repeated appearance across the output sequence.
Evaluating demographic and intersectional fairness coverage when generating images conditioned on prompts like 'overweight person' or incorporating 'fuller-figured' as an evaluated feature.

Measuring approximate intersectional fairness using k-way combinatorial testing by tracking whether all pairwise combinations of sensitive attributes (demographics, gender, occupation, body size) appear within a generated sequence of a polynomially-bounded size.
